# 꺄(Kyaa)

> Kyaa is a fan platform operated by Sallylab Inc. Fans can discover creators and LIVE schedules, reserve a spot, and record participation in a Fan Passport. The Korean brand name is 꺄(Kyaa).

## Public information

- [Korean home](https://kyaa.io/?locale=ko): Service introduction and public content.
- [English home](https://kyaa.io/?locale=en): Service introduction in English.
- [Service guide](https://kyaa.io/guide?locale=en): How to use Kyaa and frequently asked questions.
- [Sitemap](https://kyaa.io/sitemap.xml): Public canonical URLs and language alternatives.

## Official channels

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kyaa_app/)
- [X](https://x.com/kyaa_app)
- [Threads](https://www.threads.com/@kyaa_app)
- [Telegram](https://t.me/Kyaa_Official)

Contact: support@kyaa.io. Supported locales: ko, en, ja, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, id, vi, th, pt, fr, ru. Use each page's locale parameter to select its language. Reservations, attendance and benefit entries are distinct actions; consult the current event's public conditions.
